dhp167:1: One should not follow lowly things, one should not abide heedlessly,
dhp167:3: one should not follow a wrong view, one should not foster worldliness.
dhp168:1: One should strive, not be heedless, one should live by Dhamma, with good conduct,
dhp168:3: living by Dhamma one lives at ease in this world and the next.
dhp169:1: One should live by Dhamma, with good conduct, not with bad conduct,
dhp169:3: living by Dhamma one lives at ease in this world and the next.
dhp170:2: One should see it as a bubble, one should see it as a mirage,
dhp170:3: looking on the world in this way the King of Death does not see (one).
dhp171:1: Come, look upon this world adorned like a king’s gilded chariot,
dhp171:4: where fools become depressed – there is no bond for those who understand.
dhp172:2: Whoever was heedless before, but later is not heedless,
dhp172:4: that one shines brightly on this world like the moon released from a cloud.
dhp173:1: The one whose wicked deed is covered over by a good deed –
dhp173:4: that one shines brightly on this world like the moon released from a cloud.
dhp174:2: This world is blind, few here have true insight,
dhp174:4: as few go to heaven as birds that escape from the net.
dhp175:1: Geese go through the path of the sky, they go through the firmament by their power,
dhp175:3: the wise are led out of the world, after beating Māra and his host.
dhp176:1: For the person speaking falsely, who has transgressed in this one thing,
dhp176:4: who has abandoned the next world, there is no wickedness left undone.
dhp177:1: The miserly go not to the world of the gods,
dhp177:2: fools surely do not praise giving,
dhp177:3: but the wise one rejoices in giving,
dhp177:4: and through that he is happy hereafter.
dhp178:2: Having sole sovereignty over the earth, or going to heaven,
dhp178:4: or lordship over the whole world – better is the fruit of stream-entry.
dhp178:5: The Chapter about the World, the Thirteenth
